_about: The one place the approved voice settings live. Source of truth for the descriptions is bible/characters.md; voice.py refuses to run if they differ.

characters.nio: A 21-year-old Black American guy, light-skinned, lower-mid pitch, warm and a little husky, quick and animated like the lead of a cartoon comedy; confident, cocky, playful; big swings between deadpan and excited; casual Gen Z delivery.
characters.maya: A young woman around 20, bright, sweet and earnest voice, soft and clear, slightly higher pitch, gentle and kind, a little breathless when excited; sincere and literal, like the kind sidekick in a cartoon.

refused_characters.friend: The best friend has no approved voice (bible/characters.md).
